annotations.title: Get fantasy football value risers and fallers

description: The NFL players whose fantasy football trade value rose or fell the most over the last week (or up to four weeks), in dynasty or redraft, Superflex or 1QB, for all positions or one. Returns each player's value, change and points scored last week. Use for "who is rising?", "buy low or sell high candidates", "whose value dropped?".

format.description: dynasty (keeper, multi-year value) or redraft (rest of this season only)

limit.description: How many risers and how many fallers to return

position.description: Only this position. Omit for all positions

superflex.description: True for Superflex or 2QB leagues. Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

weeks.description: Compare with this many weeks ago: 1 for the last week, up to 4

name: get_value_movers
title: Get fantasy football value risers and fallers
